messages:
maya (design): Saw a regression in the mobile console during user testing: on narrow viewports the Runs table gets a horizontal scrollbar and the right-side details panel (drawer) pushes parts of the row offscreen. Long model names + version strings are wrapping the header and making the drawer very tall. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/mobile-reg :grimacing:

otto (frontend): I can repro at 412px and 360px. The culprit is .cell--actions min-width + the drawer using a fixed 420px width. That combination forces horizontal scroll.

ria (product): this impacts our on-call flow — support can't open runs quickly on phones. Can we prioritize a small-scope fix first please?

maya (design): small-scope proposal: 1) at <=480px make the drawer a bottom sheet (full-width / slide-up) so it doesn't push content, 2) collapse non-primary actions into a kebab and reduce actions cell min-width, 3) stack label/value pairs inside each row at <=420px so primary id is always left-aligned. I'll add figma variants for 320/375/412.

sam (mobile): bottom-sheet is fine UX-wise. Note for iOS we need to respect safe-area-inset and allow swipe-to-dismiss. Also ensure the sheet doesn't create a second scrollable container when keyboard is open.

otto (frontend): technical notes: we use react-window for virtualization. If rows change height unpredictably we must switch to VariableSizeList or keep row heights stable by using a collapsed inline details row that is toggled. Quick fix plan: remove .cell--actions min-width, show kebab at @media (max-width:420px), and convert drawer to position:fixed bottom sheet at <=480px. Keep same DOM tree for rows so virtualization is unaffected.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y checklist: bottom sheet must use role="dialog" + aria-modal="true"; trap focus inside the sheet and restore focus to trigger on close; announce opening with aria-live or accessible name; kebab button should have aria-label="More actions for run" and menu items must be keyboard operable. When stacking rows, ensure reading order matches visual order.

ria (product): copy tweak: change drawer header from "Model run details: <full-name>" to "Run summary 539 <short-id>" and put full model name on a second, smaller line truncated with ellipsis. Long-press (or press-and-hold) should reveal the full name for touch users. Improves scan speed.

otto (frontend): I'll add a CSS hook (class: mobile-runs-layout) and gate the change behind ff_mobile_runs_layout so we can canary it. Plan: spike this afternoon -> PR by Tue -> QA Wed.

jo (qa): QA checklist I'll add to the ticket: no horizontal scroll at 320/375/412 widths; actions kebab target >=44px; bottom sheet traps focus and restores to trigger; long-press reveals full model name; safe-area-inset respected; landscape rotation doesn't create double scrollbars. Also test with screen readers (iOS VoiceOver + Android TalkBack).

maya (design): uploaded Figma frames: https://figma.com/file/xyz/mobile-runs-bottomsheet-stacked. Acceptance criteria: 1) no horizontal overflow at 360/412/480 widths, 2) drawer becomes bottom sheet below 480px with accessible focus trap, 3) primary id remains easily tappable, 4) kebab accessible and labeled.

sam (mobile): FYI on swipe-to-close: implement a subtle drag handle and require a 50px swipe threshold to avoid accidental dismiss. Keep an explicit close button too.

otto (frontend): noted re: swipe threshold. I'll include a11y attributes, the CSS snippet, and feature flag in the PR description.

ria (product): timeline: please try to get the quick fix into next patch. Mobile triage regression is high priority.

otto (frontend): targeting spike today, PR Tue, canary Wed behind ff_mobile_runs_layout.

maya (design): thanks all. I'll add the acceptance criteria to the ticket and link the figma. :thumbsup:
